summary: I wrote the full copy for the 2-sided A5 flyer, with every block in Hindi (Devanagari) and Hinglish. The front offers a Free GST Health Check: 15 minutes, last 2 quarters of GSTR-1/3B, an ITC mismatch check and a late-fee check, ending in a green/amber/red health card. It also carries the published ₹1,499/quarter fixed GST price. The back offers Belated ITR for AY 2026-27 before 31 Dec [verify]. It covers 3 steps (AIS/26AS check, review by CA Prateek Arora, filing proof on WhatsApp), a document checklist and the price as ₹[owner to set]. Each side gets its own wa.me QR placeholder with a different pre-filled message, so you can see which offer each lead came from. The file also has 3 headline options per side with reasons, CTA variants, design notes and a 6-item checklist to clear before printing. The service guarantee, referral offer, late-fee amounts and any client counts or review claims are left out on purpose, because they aren't cleared or don't exist yet.
